race.comment: AETHELWULF (3) brings serious staying hype after two dominant wins and this looks the natural next step.  ANTHRACITE (6) has the fitness edge and looks well placed fourth up on the quick back up. KENMARE BAY (5) will need the pace on with all the main dangers ahead of him but he can still sting late. SHINY NEW DEEL (4) has not fired since resuming but Clark taking over is a key switch and he should be much more handy. BELLE DETELLE (8) needs them to overdo it up front then she can burst through late.
